1st place: Watch Cyril Junior Dim – the 2022 Toastmasters International World Champion of Public Speaking – deliver his winning speech "Ndini." 

To learn more about the World Championship of Public Speaking(R) visit https://www.toastmasters.org/events/2022-international-convention/world-championship-of-public-speaking.
